criteria.text: A single repeatable command run from `apps/electron` produces an UNSIGNED macOS `.app` bundle. No code signing, no notarization, no Apple credentials are involved or required.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c1: one command produces the unsigned macOS app bundle
criteria.reason: npm run package:mac produces dist/Rhythm.app; verified by contract test 1.

criteria.text: The packaged bundle's web assets byte-match `apps/web/dist` (compare by SHA-256 per file, not by count), preserving the Slice 5 invariant that the shell consumes only `../web/dist` with no divergent renderer copy.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c2: packaged web assets byte-match apps/web/dist by SHA-256
criteria.reason: Packaged web assets byte-match apps/web/dist by per-file SHA-256; verified by test 2.

criteria.text: Launching the PACKAGED app (the built `.app` binary — NOT `electron .` from source) registers the `rhythm` protocol before ready and loads `rhythm://app/index.html#/agents` with the same hardened BrowserWindow options Slice 5 asserts.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c3: packaged binary registers rhythm before ready and loads the hardened agents window
criteria.reason: Packaged binary registers rhythm and loads the hardened agents window; verified by test 3.

criteria.text: Packaged LIVE smoke: the packaged app, pointed at the sandbox (API `http://127.0.0.1:4098`, engine `http://127.0.0.1:4097`), reaches Live mode — the environment receipt reads `Live` — and completes at least one real read through the live gateway (HTTP 200 from a real `/agent-sessions` or `/tasks` request). No fixture fallback may satisfy this.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c4: packaged live smoke reaches Live and completes a real gateway read
criteria.reason: Packaged live smoke reached Live and completed a real gateway read against :4098/:4097; verified by test 4.

criteria.text: Security invariants hold IN THE PACKAGED APP, asserted against the packaged binary: no Node in the renderer, preload exposes only the frozen versioned lifecycle object, and navigation, popups, permissions, downloads, and malformed `rhythm://` requests all fail closed.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c5: packaged binary preserves renderer isolation and fail-closed policies
criteria.reason: Packaged binary preserves renderer isolation and fail-closed policies; verified by test 5.

criteria.text: Packaging is deterministic and clean: the artifact lands in a gitignored location, re-running the command reproduces it, and the packaged smoke leaks no disposable rows, listeners, worktrees, or branches.
criteria.test_id: slice-7-c6: packaging is deterministic, gitignored, and leak-free
criteria.reason: Deterministic repackage, gitignored artifact, and leak-free: c6 strengthened to assert no persistent userData at ~/Library/Application Support/rhythm-electron-shell and no stray isolated temp dirs. Both assertions mutation-proved to fail against planted leaks.
